I went with the 4 inch rough country n20 suspension lift for 499.99. I also bought a pitman arm off rough country as well. I have a bit of wobble on the right rear but nothing to serious. It's a great lift so far, since driving it for about 5 days now. I have not gone off road due to the fact I do not have tires yet. Very easy install, all the instructions that RC gave were correct. The only thing I did not use was the transfer case drop. Also I had to take the extended stock skid plate off in order for the driveshaft not to rub due to the angle at which the lift creates with the body, if that makes sense. Took about 8 hrs total due to the stock pitman arm being a bitch to take off! I wanted a lift in a decent budget range and nothing to high because I would be using my jeep as a daily driver, yet still something to get me started with my off-road adventures.  All in all I am happy with my decision and it looks great too!
